atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: defines design tokens (colours, fonts, shadows) as CSS variables and generates the matching utility classes.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: adds a folder or file for Tailwind to scan for class names.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: registers a custom utility class that works with variants such as hover: and lg:.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: applies a Tailwind variant (for example dark or hover) to styles inside a rule.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: defines a custom variant.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: inlines existing utility classes into a rule.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: imports a stylesheet for reference only, without emitting its CSS.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: loads a JavaScript plugin.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: loads a legacy JavaScript configuration file.
